verses.en: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.pt: Senhor, Deus meu, confio, salva-me de todo o que me persegue, e livra-me;
verses.en_web: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
verses.en_bbe: <Shiggaion of David; a song which he made to the Lord, about the words of Cush the Benjamite.> O Lord my God, I put my faith in you; take me out of the hands of him who is cruel to me, and make me free;

verses.en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.pt: para que ele não me arrebate, qual leão, despedaçando-me, sem que haja quem acuda.
verses.en_web: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
verses.en_bbe: So that he may not come rushing on my soul like a lion, wounding it, while there is no one to be my saviour.

verses.en: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.pt: Senhor, Deus meu, se eu fiz isto, se há perversidade nas minhas mãos,
verses.en_web: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
verses.en_bbe: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if my hands have done any wrong;

verses.en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.pt: se paguei com o mal àquele que tinha paz comigo, ou se despojei o meu inimigo sem causa.
verses.en_web: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),
verses.en_bbe: If I have given back evil to him who did evil to me, or have taken anything from him who was against me without cause;

verses.en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.pt: persiga-me o inimigo e alcance-me; calque aos pés a minha vida no chão, e deite no pó a minha glória.
verses.en_web: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Let my hater go after my soul and take it; let my life be crushed to the earth, and my honour into the dust. (Selah.)

verses.en: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
verses.pt: Ergue-te, Senhor, na tua ira; levanta-te contra o furor dos meus inimigos; desperta-te, meu Deus, pois tens ordenado o juízo.
verses.en_web: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
verses.en_bbe: Come up, Lord, in your wrath; be lifted up against my haters; be awake, my God, give orders for the judging.

verses.en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.pt: Reúna-se ao redor de ti a assembléia dos povos, e por cima dela remonta-te ao alto.
verses.en_web: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
verses.en_bbe: The meeting of the nations will be round you; take your seat, then, over them, on high.

verses.en: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.pt: O Senhor julga os povos; julga-me, Senhor, de acordo com a minha justiça e conforme a integridade que há em mim.
verses.en_web: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will be judge of the peoples; give a decision for me, O Lord, because of my righteousness, and let my virtue have its reward.

verses.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.pt: Cesse a maldade dos ímpios, mas estabeleça-se o justo; pois tu, ó justo Deus, provas o coração e os rins.
verses.en_web: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
verses.en_bbe: O let the evil of the evil-doer come to an end, but give strength to the upright: for men's minds and hearts are tested by the God of righteousness.

verses.en: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.pt: O meu escudo está em Deus, que salva os retos de coração.
verses.en_web: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
verses.en_bbe: God, who is the saviour of the upright in heart, is my breastplate.

verses.en: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.pt: Deus é um juiz justo, um Deus que sente indignação todos os dias.
verses.en_web: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
verses.en_bbe: God is the judge of the upright, and is angry with the evil-doers every day.

verses.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.pt: Se o homem não se arrepender, Deus afiará a sua espada; armado e teso está o seu arco;
verses.en_web: If a man doesn’t relent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
verses.en_bbe: If a man is not turned from his evil, he will make his sword sharp; his bow is bent and ready.

verses.en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.pt: já preparou armas mortíferas, fazendo suas setas inflamadas.
verses.en_web: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
verses.en_bbe: He has made ready for him the instruments of death; he makes his arrows flames of fire.

verses.en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.pt: Eis que o mau está com dores de perversidade; concedeu a malvadez, e dará à luz a falsidade.
verses.en_web: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
verses.en_bbe: That man is a worker of evil; the seed of wrongdoing has given birth to deceit.

verses.en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.pt: Abre uma cova, aprofundando-a, e cai na cova que fez.
verses.en_web: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
verses.en_bbe: He has made a hole deep in the earth, and is falling into the hole which he has made

verses.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.pt: A sua malvadez recairá sobre a sua cabeça, e a sua violência descerá sobre o seu crânio.
verses.en_web: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
verses.en_bbe: His wrongdoing will come back to him, and his violent behaviour will come down on his head.

verses.en: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
verses.pt: Eu louvarei ao Senhor segundo a sua justiça, e cantarei louvores ao nome do Senhor, o Altíssimo.
verses.en_web: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
verses.en_bbe: I will give praise to the Lord for his righteousness; I will make a song to the name of the Lord Most High.
